sources.snippet: Researchers have developed the world's first large language model dedicated to Ancient Greek, using artificial intelligence to reconstruct missing passages in historical documents and potentially uncover new evidence about life in the ancient world. sources.snippet: New language model developed by the Austrian Academy of Sciences and Mistral. "Apollo" restores gaps in fragmentary ancient texts. The world's first foundation LLM for Ancient Greek.
